title: EDGE-018-playoff-gauntlet-advancement-rules
universal_lens: Playoff gauntlet forms a finite state transducer over contestant rankings with tie-breaking equivalence classes. Legal and data boundaries impose hard constraints as invariant predicates. Feature flags implement a three-valued logic (disabled, staging, production) with monotonic rollback. Schema validation constitutes a dependent type checker over mock data.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats advancement as Bayesian updating over latent skill parameters with conformal prediction sets for tie regions. Legal boundaries encode prior support constraints. Feature flags implement sequential testing with Type I error control. Rollback provides a martingale stopping boundary for deployment risk.
gse_mapping: GSE models gauntlet as a directed acyclic graph of match states with transition kernels defined by advancement rules. Tie handling induces non-deterministic branching resolved by deterministic tie-break functions. Feature flags gate state-space exploration. Rollback implements state restoration via checkpointed snapshots.
